scoring_justification: Analytical spin-wave predictions are recomputed from public parameters (T, J, N, a2D) and compared to the agent's reported simulated moments with tolerance; full recompute from raw MC samples is infeasible without access to the agent's simulation trace.

hidden_assets.purpose: Analytical spin-wave mean magnetization and susceptibility/variance used as reference for comparing simulation moments.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from equations (4) and (8) in the paper, with parameters T=0.5, J=1, N=1024, a2D=258.6.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed from the formulas using standard math functions in the checker's prepare block.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are exact analytic values derived from the paper's own formulas; the checker recomputes them to ensure correctness.

outputs.description: Monte Carlo magnetization moments (mean, variance, skewness) and the theoretically expected spin‑wave values (analytical_mean, analytical_chi). The hidden checker recomputes the expected references and verifies mean and variance within tolerance and skewness ≥0.1.

steps.description: Check simulated mean magnetization within 5% of analytical spin-wave mean.
Check variance within 5% of analytical spin-wave expectation.
